court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J. and G. Arul Murugan, J.)
appellants: Commissioner of Land Administration and Others
case_number: W.A. No. 1333 of 2026 and C.M.P. No. 12353 of 2026
judgment_text:
Prayer : appeal filed under Clause 15 of the letters patent seeking to set aside the order dated 2-3-2026 made in W.P. No. 6355 of 2026.

The Judgment of the Court was delivered by

Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J.:— This appeal is covered by the judgment of this Court dated 28-4-2026 passed in W.A. No. 883 of 2026 etc. batch.

2. In view of the above, this appeal stands dismissed in terms of the judgment dated 28-4-2026 passed in W.A. No. 883 of 2026 etc. batch. Consequently, the interim application is also dismissed.
